attributes.name: Druva - API Token Deleted
attributes.description: Detects api token deleted in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 6 – Security Configuration & Integrations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 6 – Security Configuration & Integrations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects api token deleted in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE TO_LOWER(COALESCE(message, "")) LIKE "*api*token*delet*"
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
